# Free QR Code Generator — No Signup, No Expiry

> A free, privacy-first QR code generator. No account required, no expiry, and nothing you type is ever uploaded — QR codes are generated entirely client-side in the browser (a lightweight ~6KB reactive framework, petite-vue, plus a small QR-encoding library — no build step, no bundler).

## Pages

- [QR Code Generator](https://qrcodenosignup.com/): Generate a static QR code, free, with no signup. Supports three content types — plain link/text, a dedicated Wi-Fi network preset (network name, password, security type, hidden-network option), and a vCard preset (name, organization, phone, email, website). Adjustable error correction level, padding, and export size (64–1024px), plus custom foreground/background colors with a built-in contrast checker. Download as PNG or SVG, or copy directly to the clipboard.

## Facts

- Source code: https://github.com/vumaq/free-qr-code-generator_no-signup
- Free, no signup or account required, no watermark
- Generates static QR codes — the content is encoded directly into the code itself, not behind a redirect or tracking service, so codes never expire or get deactivated
- Runs entirely client-side in the browser; nothing typed is uploaded to a server
- Three content types: Text, Wi-Fi, vCard
- Wi-Fi mode generates the correct WIFI:T:...;S:...;P:...;; format automatically, including special-character escaping
- vCard mode generates a standard vCard, which most phones offer to save directly to contacts when scanned
- Export formats: PNG, SVG, or copy to clipboard
- Adjustable error correction levels: Low, Standard, Strong, Max
- Adjustable quiet zone (padding): None, Small, Standard, Large
- Adjustable export size: 64px to 1024px
- A QR code can hold up to about 4,296 alphanumeric characters, or around 7,089 digits, at the lowest error correction level
- Settings (content type, error correction, size, padding, colors) persist across visits via local storage; typed content never persists
